title: a-proof-run-by-hand-outside-cairn-test-runs-under-the-seal
intention: A CC tool call that runs a proof by python path runs under the tester's instance seal instead, rewritten at PreToolUse; one that runs pytest is refused with the `cairn test` line.
why: A CC session running a proof by hand (python3 <proof>, pytest <proof>) runs it outside the tester's instance seal, against live ~/.cairn. Measured 2026-10-06: 88 of 290 proofs write live state that way (2705 paths: dated emissions, inference tickets, tester run files, appends to bus.log and last_known), and this session's own first e9a2 run leaked 6 inference tickets. The lived symptom: the operator's live logs and trouble lanes fill with fixture records nobody can tell from real ones, and one proof overwrote the live superclaude loop.pid. 313 files of standing advice say `python3 <proof>`; a refuse-then-retype gate would leave all of them contradicting it and cost a turn per follower, so the python3 hand is rewritten under the seal instead (peer akiendelllinux_cc_0, 2026-10-06). Parent: dda0e72b9c67.
traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics): 'run proofs via cairn test' is a sentence in memory and the e9a2 leak shows it failing; Law 8 (a proof's run must not damage the world it measures); Law 5 (the 313 advice lines stay true in effect). Parent dda0e72b9c67.
how: New bin/cmd/proofgate, shaped like bin/cmd/deletegate (stdin JSON {tool_name, tool_input.command}). When the command TEXT runs pytest in any spelling (pytest, py.test, python -m pytest): exit 2, stderr naming `bin/cairn test <proof>`. Else when it runs a file under a proofs/ directory by python (incl. env/timeout/strace prefixes, cd then a relative path, the module form, a loop running a variable over a proofs/ glob): exit 0 with hookSpecificOutput {hookEventName: PreToolUse, permissionDecision: allow, permissionDecisionReason and additionalContext saying it was rewritten, updatedInput: {command: '<repo>/bin/cairn test --exec ' + shlex.quote(original)}} (Claude Code hooks docs, code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks, read 2026-10-06). Else exit 0 silent: cairn test itself, reads of proofs, other python. Registered in .claude/settings.json PreToolUse matcher Bash beside deletegate. Depends on 2c9eeab2da87 (cairn test --exec). Proof bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py, written red.
falsifier: Done when (1) python3-by-path spellings (`python3 cairn/devices/x/proofs/test_y.py`, `cd cairn && python3 devices/x/proofs/test_y.py`, env/timeout/strace prefixes, the module form, a loop over a proofs/ glob) exit 0 with permissionDecision allow and updatedInput.command == `<repo>/bin/cairn test --exec ` + shlex.quote(original), and a note that the command was rewritten; (2) `pytest cairn/tools/base/proofs/` and `python3 -m pytest -q x.py` exit 2 with a stderr carrying `cairn test`; (3) `bin/cairn test --seal cairn/devices/x/proofs/test_y.py`, `cat cairn/devices/x/proofs/test_y.py` and `python3 -c 'print(1)'` exit 0 with no output; (4) .claude/settings.json registers it under PreToolUse matcher Bash; (5) every per-proof command the census harness ran, rebuilt for every proof on disk, is refused (pytest) or rewritten (python3), never passed bare; (6) a rewritten fixture proof run end to end prints CAIRN_TESTER_INSTANCE_SEALED=1; (7) a rewritten command carrying single quotes, double quotes and a pipe runs end to end under the seal with the same stdout as the bare command it replaced. WRONG INTENT if a legitimate CC workflow measured in the corpus needs a raw proof run that the seal cannot serve. Scripts that run proofs from a file pass unseen: census 2026-10-06 measured 0 such executors besides codemother's verdict (68cef2ddd8ef), recorded at BUILDME.

decisions.text: bin/cmd/proofgate (python3, chmod +x, sibling of bin/cmd/deletegate): read stdin JSON; tool_name != Bash exits 0. command = tool_input.command. judge(command): empty or already containing 'cairn test' -> None; pytest/py.test/'-m pytest' -> refuse; else cut the text at ; && || | newline do then, and a segment runs a proof when its command word (past VAR=v assignments and prefixes timeout strace env nice nohup stdbuf time ionice setsid exec) is python[0-9.]* and an arg matches proofs/(...)/test_*.py, or '-m' then a module proofs.(...).test_x, or a $var while the whole text has a proofs/...test_ glob -> rewrite. <repo> = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]. Refuse: stderr names bin/cairn test, exit 2. Rewrite: stdout JSON {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: PreToolUse, permissionDecision: allow, permissionDecisionReason: TOLD, additionalContext: TOLD, updatedInput: {**tool_input, command: '<repo>/bin/cairn test --exec ' + shlex.quote(command)}}}, exit 0, TOLD containing 'proofgate rewrote this command'. Else exit 0 silent.
decisions.step: unlisted: Write bin/cmd/proofgate handling pytest/python-path/other cases; register in .claude/settings.json PreToolUse Bash matcher

decisions.text: Register in .claude/settings.json: append to hooks.PreToolUse a new entry {matcher: Bash, hooks: [{type: command, command: $HOME/dev/src/cairn/bin/cmd/proofgate, timeout: 10}]} beside the deletegate and artifactgate entries; change nothing else.
decisions.step: unlisted: write bin/cmd/proofgate and register in .claude/settings.json

decisions.text: Write the string literally as $HOME/dev/src/cairn/bin/cmd/proofgate, unexpanded, exactly as the deletegate entry at .claude/settings.json line 43 does; Claude Code runs hook commands through the shell, which expands $HOME at runtime.

The $var case, by example: 'for f in cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_*.py; do python3 $f; done' is rewritten whole — the segment 'python3 $f' has command word python3 and an arg starting with $, and the whole text contains 'proofs/test_'. 'python3 $f' with no proofs/...test_ anywhere in the text passes untouched.

Segmenting is deliberately NOT quote-aware (a hook stays short of a shell parser, as bin/cmd/deletegate explains): the raw text is split by the regex '&&|\|\||[;|\n]|\bdo\b|\bthen\b', quotes and escapes included; each segment is then tokenized with shlex.split(segment, comments=False), falling back to segment.split() on a ValueError (an unbalanced quote left by the cut). $var and $(...) are never expanded — a token starting with $ counts only by the glob rule in D7. A quote containing ; can only ADD a rewrite (the rewritten command still runs whole under the seal), never remove one, because the rewrite carries the original whole text.

CORRECTION to D8, measured 2026-10-06: a quoted ; or | CAN remove a rewrite. X="a;b" python3 cairn/x/proofs/test_y.py passes bare (exit 0, no output), because the cut lands inside the quotes and neither segment's command word is python. The built gate keeps the D8 segmenting as is; this miss is recorded, not handled. It sits outside the falsifier's named spellings, and all 364 x 4 census spellings rewrite or refuse.

measured_at_build: 2026-10-06. (1) Census that bore the ticket (parent dda0e72b9c67): every proof run under raw pytest with strace -f, 88 of 290 wrote into live ~/.cairn, 2705 paths. (2) proofgate judge() dry-run over every proof in the repo (364 files under proofs/): 'python3 <proof>' rewritten 364/364, 'pytest <proof>' refused 364/364, 'cat|sed|grep <proof>' untouched 364/364, 0 bare. (3) bin/cairn test bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py test_delete_gate.py test_artifact_gate.py: 3 green, 0 red (diagnostic). (4) measured: Claude Code picks up a PreToolUse hook added to .claude/settings.json mid-session — proofgate refused the installing session's own commands. [Corrected 2026-10-06 by 72a37498c601; the earlier reading, that hooks do not reload mid-session, was measured false.] (5) Side finding: the segment tokenizer counts a proof path inside a trailing '# comment' as an arg, so such a command is rewritten — harmless (it still runs, sealed), recorded not fixed.
